notes: A section-chain map: four sections of door blocks, each a few lanes joined by the floor's pit teleports, and a door-sized gate at the end of each section into the next (t11 -> t1111 -> t1717 -> t2121 -> t2727). The START is the spawn room every info_player stands in, which is also where section 1's pits return you (t11 at -352 -352). The stages are the gates' arrivals: t1111 (1344 -352), t1717 (-384 -1728) and t2121 (1344 -1728). The FINISH is where the last gate (model *216 at 1252 -864) puts you, t2727 at (-864 -288): a hub room whose five teleports are the map's own menu -- top1..top4 to an upper copy of each section, bonus1 to the bonus -- and nothing in it is a section. DOUBTS: the room-as-finish is read from the teleport graph (it is the only arrival nothing in a section leads back to), not from an entity; the upper 'top' route and the bonus are not timed tracks yet.
